paper_title: Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge An Ever-Scaling   Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs
caption: Ever-scalingness
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the conceptual framework of "Ever-scalingness" for a reasoning benchmark, divided into exactly four equal slices that each represent an estimated 25% of the total area. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit percentage labels; instead, it utilizes direct labeling where each segment contains an internal text label and a corresponding black line-art icon, accompanied by an external text box outlined in the slice's respective color. Starting from the top right and moving clockwise, the first slice is light blue, labeled "Instance" internally with a shield icon, and linked to an external box reading "Unhackable". The bottom right slice is light green, labeled "Coverage" with a gear and globe icon, and corresponds to the external label "General". The bottom left slice is red, labeled "Scalable Oversight" with a clipboard icon, and is paired with the external label "Auto-verifiable". The top left slice is yellow, labeled "Complexity" with a ladder icon, and corresponds to the external label "Uncrushable". Because all segments represent identical proportions, there is no size-based ordering. Visually, the four slices are slightly offset from one another, separated by a distinct white, cross-shaped gap that evenly divides the quadrants.
